newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tigon listing reinstated after suspension.
newsitem.headline: Tigon listing reinstated after suspension.

text.p: Financial services group Tigon Ltd said on Friday that its listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange would be reinstated from the start of business today following the publication of further financial information.
The JSE suspended the listing on Wednesday pending publication of an announcement by Tigon relating to a substantial source of its earnings as disclosed in abridged results for the year to January.
Tigon has now provided information about its Asia Pacific Sorucing Ltd unit.
